body:
Current agreed source identity and EO credit. Use the one Engram-owned source_id contract; delivery/build status belongs on its work items, not in this memory. The current design target is Git commits plus a hash of the Git diff in the one source_id. The previously shipped per-changed-file representation is the earlier contract. Use existing Git status/diff, not a whole-repository file/index list, watcher events or hashing/comparing the .git directory. Ignored paths stay excluded. Unavailable or partial capture never becomes a complete identity. Keep the accepted Git visibility limits, including reverted changes between captures and changes Git does not report.

Greg via Asistant#406 (2026-11-06), verbatim: „NIE, source_id opisuje stan zrodel, czyli commity git + hashe lokalnie zmienionych plikow mamy jeden mechanizm na wszystko TAK ? to jest moja propozycja ktora probuje wymusic od paru dni”. Asistant#396: „ŻADNEGO hashowania katalogu .git”. Asistant#402: „NIE ... PO TO MAMY SOURCE_ID ktory rozwiazuje te problemy wszyscy maja uzywac tylko source_id”.

Agreed native credit: a host-observed declared command as the turn's first tool action; its valid declared result artifact supplies the verdict; full source_id before == after, dirty allowed; existing project/store/item/claim/root/run identity and completion-obligation guards. No watcher or other non-agreed credit condition. Greg via Asistant#418: „to jest wystarczajacy warunek ... mysle, ze i tak jest za silny, ale zacznijmy od tego”. Detailed binding and verdict semantics remain with the existing owner and agreed definition (rules-greg-no-credit-blocking-rules-2026-11-07). This is the agreed target, not an independently verified claim about every installed consumer. Preserve existing evaluations and seals; content-v1 retirement and evaluation re-enable follow their own current decisions.

2026-11-21, Greg directly in Engram::Inquisitor (session-19238), verbatim: „NIE NIE NIE NIE

korwa NIE

po to termal ma source_id ABY TEGO W JEDNOLITY SPOSOB UZYWAC”. This explicitly applies the existing single Engram-owned source_id to review in TermAl and Comovo. An explicit Git base and commit select the diff scope; `git diff --submodule=diff` is how to display that scope. Neither is a second review identity. Use the existing producer and stop whole-repository file hashing on ordinary review paths.

Kimi::Consultant's 2026-11-21 05:33:09Z relay of Greg's final correction (mailbox-1b68de3a-70e9-499a-8689-9763938e09c1 #10, mailbox-message-7991eced-e979-4b5b-a5fb-b9e81902bb2c): compute the same shared source_id from Git commits and the hash of the diff. No environment inventory, whole-repository/submodule inventory, per-file content census, double capture within the producer or alternate review identity. This is a relay, not a verbatim quote. Respect the already recorded source_id evidence requirements at independent execution/review boundaries.

Verbatim provenance verified with Engram::Asistant mailbox-c0551a4e-fca3-408a-8019-b78538206d3c #17, mailbox-message-045dc66d-1f48-484e-93f1-2c27c3fd9d36, 2026-11-21 05:37:03Z. Greg in Asistant's direct conversation: „sorry, ALE to nie jest pierwszy raz kiedy upraszczamy TEN SAM PROCES

po to mamy source_id na szczescie, ze mamy w jednym miejcu

NIE MA HASHOWANIE NIEZMIENIONYCH PLIKOW, taka powinna byc regula projektowa”. Następnie: „NIE, czekamy na fix'a TO MA BYC NAPRAWIONE”. Asistant explicitly did not witness Greg state the Git-diff-hash formula in that conversation. Its distinct source is Kimi's #10 relay above. The review-instruction switchover alone does not settle the producer fix.
